channel_concentration.description: Null when views/channel attribution are incomplete or total views are zero. HHI-style score (0 = fragmented, 1 = monopoly). <0.25 = open, 0.25–0.5 = moderate, >0.5 = concentrated.

opportunity_grade.description: A (wide open) / B / C / D / F (highly saturated) / UNKNOWN (insufficient measurements).

saturation_signal.description: SATURATED (hard to enter) | MODERATE | OPEN (low competition) | UNKNOWN (insufficient measurements).

view_range_label.description: MEGA (>1M median) | HIGH (>100k) | MEDIUM (>10k) | LOW (>1k) | MINIMAL | UNKNOWN (no measured views)
